metadata.title: Asymptotic connectivity, hamiltonicity and toughness
metadata.abstract: We define coarse variants of the notions of connectivity, hamiltonicity, toughness, and spanning trees. Our notions are invariant under quasi-isometries, and they obey the same relationships between them as their classical analogs. We pose several open problems that are coarse versions of classical results and conjectures about hamiltonicity.
